meta.why: comp-aws metrics --graph <fixture> is one of the three READ-ONLY subcommands the deprecation preamble is exercised on. A fixture is used so the probe never touches AWS and never derives: the criterion measures the CLI SEAM (preamble first on stderr, stdout byte-identical, rc equal), not the cloud.
meta.not_a_census: This is NOT an AWS census and carries no claim about the estate. It is two synthetic nodes shaped to the compute_metrics contract.
